theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_mt_cc_cycle_of_boundary_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1 + 1)) (T₁ T₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (p : ℕ), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (n + 1), B.boundary ω = T₂ ω + (-1 : ℝ) ^ p * T₁ ω) → ∃ Z E' : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z ∧ BoundaryVanishes Z ∧ Z.support ⊆ B.support ∧ E'.mass ≤ T₂.mass ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (n + 1), Z ω = T₁ ω + E' ω
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
